topicDecisions.decision: Four new granular sample-associated domestic occurrences. Original calibrated ranges cross target boundaries without truncation. Late CE gap remains unsupported at named phase resolution.

Two independently verified Dry Creek components and one Bachner cooking context, plus five clearly labeled Swan Point model-summary records based on preserved original excerpts. Swan Point alone receives generalized public setting; other new localities remain unmapped pending defensible position.
Follow-up original-text access resolved Owl Ridge calendar units; three separate component records added, with location null pending defensible generalized position.
One new Bautista temporary-camp phase and one proposed Cuncaicha chronology correction. Lack of secure earlier Bolivian dates retained as documentation gap, not absence of people.

Nine new granular activity records: Xihuatoxtla layerD, two ChanHol illumination samples, five cave-specific mining charcoal samples and Coxcatlán ElRiego boundary-median model. No new burial duplicates or early unsupported calendar cells. All new Mexican sites remain unmapped pending independently verified generalized public positions.

Sixteen formerly null locations resolved as four coarse named-landscape proxies and twelve explicit regional overlays. All25 candidates now have geographic display context. Regional anchors do not establish exact site locations; no sensitive excavation or cave-entrance coordinates added.

Complete combined 894-record corpus audit by source DOI, titles, named places and aliases. 28 new granular findings and 2 full replacements prepared; all 30 record objects pass validateRecord with zero errors.

topicDecisions.decision: Separate architecture, burial and occupation. Keep unplaced findings unplaced. Preserve conflicting attribution as an update, not a fabricated extra phase. No population values inferred. Regional language contact has an independent linguistic source and does not label archaeological cultures.

Four directly dated artifact occurrences admitted, including two Wyoming comparators explicitly labelled. Dates derive only from published calibrated ranges with gaps/probabilities retained. No precise localities exposed; no regional-occupation claim from isolated artifacts. Western valley gap remains unresolved rather than filled with eastern-front comparators.

Completed original-source review. New granular chronology at Gatecliff, Hogup, Leonard, Alta Toquima, Marsh Creek and Prisoners Harbor. CA-VEN-863 explicitly retains supplied-original-abstract access limit. Leonard pre-existing whole-site interpretation retained with a separate source/related-record update. Unplaced open-ended Gatecliff renewal has no fabricated end. No restricted coordinates or resident counts added.
